purpose: Return the main research line to prediction quality by replacing the unstable two-stage tail objective with a fixed equal-weight 5/20-session cross-sectional rank consensus
evidence: V21 reproduced negative V13/V16 5-day and 20-day IC
Frozen global score had positive average IC but V23 showed unstable tail translation
Technology IC remained negative, so no technology success may be claimed
fixed_model: Use the existing frozen PIT V10 feature set and eligibility rules
Fit one constrained LightGBM rank-regression head for 5-session neutral rank and one for 20-session neutral rank
Use equal 0.5/0.5 sector-neutral percentile predictions; no weight search or sign reversal
Use only labels matured before each rolling training cutoff with the existing embargo
Keep the accepted V20r2 calendar, trade restrictions, costs, benchmark proxy and portfolio accounting unchanged
validation: First reproduce the V20r2 control ledger exactly
One frozen 2020-2025 walk-forward run only; this window is retrospective and not an independent holdout
Report annual IC, technology IC, tail spread, excess return, drawdown, turnover and costs without changing thresholds
prohibited: No announcement body features until prospective PIT gates pass
No top-N, horizon-weight, hyperparameter, sector-cap or holding-bonus search
No use of V25 results to create V25r1 unless there is an implementation defect
No model replacement before all original gates and 126 new future trading days
cancellation_reason: Repository audit found that V10 already fits fixed 5-session and 20-session Ridge/LightGBM heads and combines their cross-sectional ranks. V11 and V12 also already tested listwise tail objectives. No model was implemented, frozen or evaluated under this duplicate protocol.
